methods.label: Work backward from each proposed average
methods.explanation:
An average of three numbers is their total divided by \(3\). To test a proposed average, multiply it by \(3\) to recover the total, then subtract \(6+10=16\) to find the required value of \(N\). For the five choices, this gives
\[
\begin{aligned}
\text{A: }&3\times8-16=8,\\
\text{B: }&3\times10-16=14,\\
\text{C: }&3\times12-16=20,\\
\text{D: }&3\times14-16=26,\\
\text{E: }&3\times16-16=32.
\end{aligned}
\]
Only \(14\) is between \(9\) and \(17\), and indeed \((6+10+14)\div3=10\). Therefore the possible average is \(10\), choice B.
